key_insight: OpenThoughts-Agent proposes a fully open pipeline for creating training data for agentic language models, aiming to produce models that generalize across many agent tasks instead of overfitting to one benchmark. The core breakthrough is treating data curation for agents as a reusable recipe, not a one-off dataset.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of publicly available, general-purpose training data recipes for agentic models. Prior open efforts often optimize for a single benchmark, making it difficult to build agents that transfer well across diverse tasks and environments.
method: Design a fully open data curation pipeline for agentic model training.
Focus on building training data that supports broad task generalization rather than benchmark-specific performance.
Compare against existing open agent-data efforts such as SWE-Smith, SERA, and Nemotron-Terminal.
impact: This work gives practitioners a clearer path to constructing stronger open agent models with more transferable skills. It can speed up reproducible research and reduce dependence on opaque, benchmark-tuned data pipelines.

paper_title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
paper_authors: Negin Raoof, Richard Zhuang, Marianna Nezhurina, Etash Guha, Atula Tejaswi
